data.one_liner: Take screenshots during your flutter unit tests for debugging
data.what_it_does: It allows developers to capture screenshots of widget trees during Flutter unit tests by wrapping the widget tree in a Screenshotter widget and calling a tester extension method. It also supports capturing screenshots that include custom fonts and network images.
use_when: You want to visually debug Flutter unit tests using screenshots
You need to capture images of rendered widgets during automated testing
avoid_when: You are looking for golden file testing infrastructure to compare pixels against baseline images
You are not writing Flutter unit or widget tests
strengths: Simple API with a Screenshotter widget and tester extension method
Supports capturing screenshots with fonts and network images
weaknesses: Limited to debugging purposes during unit tests
Not documented for pixel-by-pixel golden test matching
data.setup_notes: Wrap the widget tree with a Screenshotter widget and call tester.screenshot() inside your testWidgets.
